held.title: Google and GitHub make Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers and GitHub Copilot
reasons: Fact check: Before says Copilot users could not select Gemini 4 Carbon. The changelog establishes general availability, but does not say whether any users had access before then.

held.title: AWS adds Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed to Amazon Bedrock
reasons: Fact check: whyCare presents keeping inference inside AWS's data boundary as an established fact. The AWS post makes this claim as AWS's own assurance, which the item does not attribute.

held.title: GitHub separates BYOK usage in Copilot reports
reasons: Fact check: The item dates the announcement November 4; the GitHub changelog identifies it as November 3, published at 16:32 -08:00.

held.title: Mistral releases Mistral Large 4 weights for self-hosting
reasons: Fact check: The item says teams could call the model through hosted services during preview, but neither source says preview access included hosted inference.

held.title: AWS adds MCP tools to Amazon Connect Customer flows
reasons: Fact check: The item dates the announcement to 2 November, but the AWS What's New URL places it in October 2026.

held.title: AWS offers OpenAI Daybreak Red in GovCloud (US-East) to eligible customers
reasons: Fact check: The item says AWS account-team approval is an access gate | The sources require OpenAI enrollment and say to contact the AWS account team to request or enable access after approval, but do not say the AWS team itself approves eligibility.

held.title: Google Cloud makes spend caps generally available
reasons: Fact check: The item says limits can be applied through policy; the sources describe API-based programmatic setup but do not state policy support.

held.title: AWS exposes Step Functions workflows as tools for AI agents
reasons: Fact check: Before: Teams wrote Lambda adapters or MCP servers to expose Step Functions; the sources say these are no longer needed but do not establish what teams previously did or had to do.
Fact check: Before: Teams encoded business sequences in agents; the sources do not say this was the prior approach.
Fact check: WhyCare: Step Functions preserves execution history without qualification; the documentation specifies execution history for Standard workflows, not Express workflows.

held.title: LangChain adds browser use and async subagents to Managed Deep Agents
reasons: Fact check: Before: Teams needed a separate browser service to use JavaScript-driven websites without APIs; the sources describe the new managed browser but do not establish this prior requirement.

held.title: AWS lets ECS tasks share NVIDIA GPUs through MPS
reasons: Fact check: The item says AWS announced this on 27 October; the What's New page gives no day in its text, and its URL specifies only October 2026.
